"
      },
      {
        speaker: 'زيد',
        text: 'نجمع البسطين: 1 + 2 = 3، ويبقى المقام 4 كما هو، إذن الناتج ثلاثة أرباع (3/4)!',
        audio: "data:audio/mpeg;base64,"
      }
    ];

    // ---------- Progress & Stars ----------
    function markTaskComplete(stageId, starKey = null) {
      if (stageId >= 2 && stageId <= 9) {
        state.completedTasks.add(stageId);
      }
      if (starKey) {
        state.stars.add(starKey);
      }
      updateChrome();
      const passport=document.getElementById('passportModal');if(passport && !passport.classList.contains('hidden'))document.getElementById('passportContent').innerHTML=renderPassport();
    }

    function updateChrome() {
      // Progress bar
      const done = state.completedTasks.size;
      document.getElementById('progressCounter').textContent = `${done} / 8`;
      document.getElementById('progressBar').style.width = `${(done / 8) * 100}%`;

      // Stars
      document.getElementById('starCountText').textContent = `${state.stars.size} / 5`;

      // Sidebar Nav
      const nav = document.getElementById('journeyNav');
      nav.innerHTML = STAGES.map(s => {
        const active = s.id === state.currentStage;
        const isDone = state.completedTasks.has(s.id);
        return `
          <button onclick="goToStage(${s.id})" class="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold transition ${
            active
              ? 'bg-[#0F3D3E] text-white shadow-sm'
              : 'bg-transparent hover:bg-[#F4EFE4] text-[#374151]'
          }">
            <span class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[11px] font-extrabold ${
                active ? 'bg-[#D96B43] text-white' : 'bg-[#F4EFE4] text-[#0F3D3E]'
              }">${s.num}</span>
              <span>${s.title}</span>
            </span>
            <span>${isDone ? '✅' : s.icon}</span>
          </button>
        `;
      }).join('');

      // Pagination
      document.getElementById('pageIndicator').textContent = `${state.currentStage} / 9`;
      document.getElementById('prevStageBtn').disabled = state.currentStage === 1;
      document.getElementById('nextStageBtn').disabled = state.currentStage === 9;
    }
